From small updates to full transformations, we handle it all.

A LOCAL, FAMILY-OWNED BUSINESS YOU CAN TRUST

At Goldsmith Remodel and Design we’re a local family business that cares about doing things the right way.

We started this company to give homeowners a better remodeling experience - one built on honesty, communication, and quality work.

When you work with us, you’re working directly with the people responsible for your project - from the first meeting to the final walkthrough.

SIMPLE, STRESS-FREE PROCESS

1

FREE CONSULTATION

Tell us about your vision and goals. 

2

IN HOME VISIT & MEASUREMENTS

We take measurements and discuss details. 

3

DETAILED ESTIMATE

Know exactly what your project will cost.

4

BUILD & ONGOING COMMUNICATION

We keep you informed every step of the way.

5

FINAL WALKTHROUGH

We ensure every detail is perfect before completion.

“What an absolute pleasure it is to work with Goldsmith Remodel and Design. We have used them for multiple projects, most recently- they took on the large task of finishing our empty basement.

From beginning to end, Joe is the most professional contractor we've ever met. He is organized and has fantastic communication skills. The team left our house clean every day! He has the vision and experience to turn a half-framed unusable space into what is now our dream basement- adding on 2 large bedrooms, a luxury bathroom, multiple closets with cabinetry, the ultimate laundry room, spacious family room with accent wall, and a play room/office space for our growing family. All in a timely manner. Joe just 'gets it'!!

The quality of work and care put into every detail shows. There is no comparison in the quality of work the Goldsmith team completes- flooring, trim, tile work, painting, shelving, etc. all turned out FANTASTIC. We are amazed and will appreciate this beautiful space for years to come.

We 1000/10 recommend this company and look forward to working with them again in the future.”

-Nicole H., Rochester

WHAT OUR CLIENTS SAY

“We are very happy with the work Joe Goldsmith Remodeling did on our kitchen and master bathroom! From start to finish, Joe and his team were great to work with. They were friendly, professional and showed genuine care about getting the job done right. Joe helped us review our original rooms and listened to our ideas for changes. He provided us with an estimated project cost which was accurate and helped us to stay within budget.
Throughout the process, Joe kept us informed every step of the way, including the expected arrivals other subcontractors. We liked that he put up barriers to keep dust to a minimum in our adjoining livings spaces and appreciated everyone cleaning up at the end of each day. The craftsmanship and attention to detail really showed. Our kitchen and bathroom turned out as we wanted and we can tell that Joe and his team take a lot of pride in their work.”

-Ernie H., Rochester

“Joe & his team took down our old decks and built us new ones with A+ workmanship. They were very professional and stuck to task. We have received multiple compliments on our new decks. I would not hesitate to recommend Goldsmith Remodel And Design to my friends and family. Quality plus!”

-Barb M., Rochester

“Very satisfied with my bathroom remodel! It’s been a while since I had the Goldsmith team remodel it- It still looks fantastic and works great. I was coming into a mess from the old house with water damage and dark dreary bathroom, and Joe and his team turned it into exactly what I wanted! Would work with the team again. Thanks for my favorite bathroom in the house!”

-Yvonne B., Rochester

ABOUT GOLDSMITH REMODEL AND DESIGN

Goldsmith Remodel and Design is based in Rochester, MN and built on hard work, honestly, and doing right by our customers. 

A local, family-run business you can trust.

Joe Goldsmith started working in the trades at a young age and quickly discovered a passion for building and transforming spaces. Over the years, he refined his craft and built a company centered around clear communication, quality work, and treating every home like his own. 

Today we are proud to be the local business that homeowners recommend to their friends and family.

OUR STORY

OUR VALUES

HONESTY

We believe in clear communication and upfront pricing.

QUALITY

We take pride in doing things the right way, not the fast way

RESPECT

We treat your home with the same care we would our own.

DEPENDABILITY

We show up, follow through, and stand behind our work.

MEET OUR TEAM

We’re a close team that truly cares about our work and our customers.

Joe Goldsmith 

Owner | Project Manager | Lead Carpenter

Lexie Goldsmith

Office Coordinator | Design

Broc McCabe 

Carpenter

We’re proud to be a part of the Rochester community and grateful for the homeowners who trust us with their homes. 

WE LOVE OUR COMMUNITY

QUALITY WORK. STRONG RELATIONSHIPS. BEAUTIFUL RESULTS.

OUR SERVICES

Thoughtful design, Quality craftsmanship, A process built around you.

We offer a full range of services to improve the look, function, and value of your home.

REAL WORK. REAL RESULTS

All photos on this website are real jobs completed by our team. 

Click on each category below to learn more and view our project photos!

Kitchens
Bathrooms
Main Level/ Basements
Windows, Doors, & Exteriors
Decks
Enclosed Porches
Progress
Before/After Pictures

REMODELING DOESN’T HAVE TO FEEL OVERWHELMING

We take the time to understand your vision, budget, and goals from the very beginning. Our process is designed to keep everything clear, organized, and moving smoothly - so you always know what to expect.

Whether you’re remodeling one room or transforming your entire home, we’re here to help create a space you’ll love for years to come.

OUR PROCESS

REACH OUT

Fill out our CONTACT form and we’ll reach out by phone or email to learn more about your project and answer any questions.

IN-HOME CONSULTATION

We’ll schedule a visit to your home to go over ideas, take measurements, and get a clear understanding of your space and goals.

DESIGN & ESTIMATE

We create a detailed quote and, upon request, complimentary 3D rendering so you can visualize your new space before construction begins.

SELECTIONS & PLANNING

Once you have accepted the quote, we’ll guide you through selecting materials, finishes, fixtures, and more - whether you’re shopping for high-end or keeping things budget friendly. We create a “shopping guide” to help you know what you need to do. Once all materials are in - demo day begins!

DEMO & CONSTRUCTION

Our crew arrives ready to work while keeping the job site as clean and organized throughout the project. We’ll stay in communication every step of the way so you’re never left wondering what’s happening.

FINAL WALKTHROUGH

Once everything is complete, we walk through the project with you to ensure every detail meets expectations and you’re loving your new space.

We require a down payment when accepting our estimate & contract and at different stages of the project.
